'''Sallow Violect''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who had previously been part of the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]]. She loudly challenged all of her targets to a public fight.
